heading: Who we are
lede: McCullough Clark is a Texas firm built by a credentialed Enrolled Agent and an Analytics Director, both with two decades of experience in the operational realities of professional services. We believe deep expertise and modern AI capability belong in the same firm, not different ones.

founder1.name: Sharla Clark, EA, MBA
founder1.title: Founder
founder1.bio: 25+ years in accounting, with the last seven serving small businesses across Texas. IRS Enrolled Agent, QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor, and the processes guru behind McCullough Clark's AI tools.

founder2.name: Whitney McCullough
founder2.title: Co-founder
founder2.bio: Business Intelligence, Analytics and Automations master with more than 20 years of experience. Builds the data infrastructure and reporting layer that turns operational AI into operational insight.
